title: Illumina Library Construction Protocol
author: SARAH SIU TZE MAK
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iajcacn
materials: To determine the number of cycles used in index PCR, perform a qPCR in a 20 µl reaction volume using 1:20 dilution of: purified library template 0.2 mM dNTPs (Invitrogen) 0.04 U/µl AmpliTaq Gold DNA polymerase (Applied Biosystems, Foster City, California, USA) 2.5 mM MgCl2 (Applied Biosystems) 1X GeneAmp® 10X PCR Buffer II (Applied Biosystems) 1 µl SYBR Green (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, California, USA) 0.2 µM forward and reverse primers mixture (IS7 and IS8 primers following Meyer and Kircher 2010) 13.48 µl AccuGene molecular biology water (Lonza)

100 µl PCR reactions containing: 20 µl of purified library 0.2 mM dNTPs (Invitrogen) 0.1 U/µl AmpliTaq Gold DNA polymerase (Applied Biosystems) 2.5 mM MgCl2 (Applied Biosystems) 1X GeneAmp® 10X PCR Buffer II (Applied Biosystems) 0.4 mg/ml BSA (New England Biolabs Inc) 0.2 µM of each forward (Illumina InPE 1.0 forward) custom made reverse primers 51.2 µl AccuGene molecular biology water (Lonza, Basel, CH)
Post-PCR, purify libraries with QiaQuick columns (Qiagen).

steps.title: End‑repair with enhancer
steps.instruction: Perform the end‑repair reaction and add 1 µl of reaction enhancer composed of 25 % polyethylene glycol (PEG4000), 2 µg/µL bovine serum albumin (BSA) and 400 mM NaCl.

steps.title: Ligation with adapters
steps.instruction: Carry out the ligation step and add 1 µl of 10 µM Illumina‑compatible adapters.

steps.title: Adapter fill‑in and column cleanup
steps.instruction: Complete the adapter fill‑in reaction, then purify the product by adding PB binding buffer at a 1:5 (v/v) ratio and applying the mixture to a Monarch DNA Cleanup Column (New England Biolabs).

substeps.instruction: Add PB binding buffer at 1:5 volume to the fill‑in reaction.
Bind the mixture to a Monarch DNA Cleanup Column.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 750 µl Buffer PE (Qiagen).

steps.title: Incubate at 37 °C (5 min)
steps.instruction: Incubate the column for 5 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA in 40 µl Buffer EB (Qiagen).

steps.title: qPCR amplification
steps.instruction: Run qPCR on the Agilent MX3005 using the following cycling conditions: 1 cycle 95 °C 10 min; 40 cycles 95 °C 30 s, 60 °C 60 s, 72 °C 60 s.

steps.title: PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Perform PCR with an initial denaturation at 95 °C for 12 min, followed by 13–21 cycles of 95 °C 30 s, 60 °C 30 s, 72 °C 40 s, and a final elongation at 72 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Incubate libraries (10 min)
steps.instruction: Incubate the libraries for 10 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Elute libraries
steps.instruction: Elute the libraries in 30 µl Buffer EB (Qiagen).

steps.title: First quantification on Bioanalyzer
steps.instruction: Take a small aliquot of the purified library and determine concentration and fragment size using the High‑Sensitivity DNA Assay kit on a Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent).

steps.title: Final AMPure XP purification
steps.instruction: Purify the library with AMPure XP beads at a 1.8× beads‑to‑library ratio to remove primer dimers and fragments smaller than 100 bp.

steps.title: Second quantification on Bioanalyzer
steps.instruction: After the final purification, again quantify a small aliquot for concentration and fragment size using the High‑Sensitivity DNA Assay kit on a Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent).

steps.title: Pool libraries equimolarly
steps.instruction: Pool the libraries in equimolar concentrations for sequencing.
